pyramiding_rule: Strictly prohibit adding to positions unless the primary order has achieved a minimum +$5.00 unrealized profit buffer.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Volume delta and order-book imbalance must confirm directional momentum for at least two consecutive 1-minute closes before order execution.
profit_harvest_threshold: Trigger aggressive trailing stops or partial scaling the moment profit crosses +$15.00, allowing runners to push to +$30.00.
